title: Reproducing Li, Luo and Ye 2023: carbon across the SiO2/4H-SiC interface after a 1400 °C oxidation

sample.paper: “commercially available n-type epitaxial 4H-SiC wafers that were (4.0 ± 0.5)◦off-axis toward <11–20>. The MOS capacitors were fabricated on the (0001) plane face.”

sample.note: The growth constants are Song 2004's on-axis Si face.

sample.paper: “The thickness of the epilayer was 10 µm, and the concentration was (5.06–10.62) × 1015 cm−3.”
sacrificial oxide removed in 10% HF before the CVD field oxide and implant
sample.ours: the growth program's 0.2 nm starting oxide
sample.note: The time between the HF strip and the 1400 °C oxidation, with a CVD and an implant in between, is not stated.

sample.paper: P, 30 keV, 10¹² or 10¹³ cm⁻² (printed “cm2”), before oxidation
sample.ours: IMPLANT_P on the sample (recorded); no program reads it
sample.note: The paper's central variable. Our growth program cannot speed up oxidation of damaged SiC.

sample.paper: “the OX-NO sample and high-imp-OX-NO sample were used to evaluate the SiO2/SiC interface morphology” (Figure 7); Figure 8 says only “w/o pretreatment” and “pretreatment”
sample.ours: the EDS rows are put on OX-NO and High-imp-OX-NO

history.paper: “First, the standard Radio Corporation of America (RCA) cleaning process was adopted for wafer cleaning.”
history.ours: CLEAN: RCA (recorded; no program reads it)

history.paper: “which was followed by the growth of a sacrificial oxide film”
history.note: Temperature, time, gas and thickness not stated. Its heat reaches the wafer; the oxide itself is stripped next.

history.item: Native and sacrificial oxide removed in 10% HF
history.paper: “The native oxide layer and sacrificial oxide layer were removed using a diluted 10% HF solution.”
history.ours: the oxide starts at the program's 0.2 nm

history.paper: “Second, a field oxide film was grown via chemical vapor deposition, which was followed by phosphorus implantation.”
history.note: Thickness, temperature and patterning not stated. Whether the implant went through it is not stated.

history.item: Wafer heats up in oxygen as it enters the 1400 °C tube (assumed)
history.paper: not stated: “the wafers were introduced into an O2 atmosphere tube at 1400 ◦C for 13 min”
history.ours: RUN PushIn DURATION 120 TEMP 1000->1400 AMBIENT dry_O2
history.note: How the wafer entered a 1400 °C tube, and whether in oxygen, is not stated. 2 min from 1000 °C is ours; searched from 10 s to 15 min.

history.paper: “the wafers were introduced into an O2 atmosphere tube at 1400 ◦C for 13 min”; Table 1: 1400, 13
history.ours: RUN Oxidation DURATION 780 TEMP 1400->1400 AMBIENT dry_O2
history.note: Dry is implied by “O2”; moisture, flow and pressure are not stated. 1400 °C is 250 °C above the range of the growth program's constants.

history.item: Pulled and cooled in oxygen to 900 °C (assumed)
history.ours: RUN Pull DURATION 300 TEMP 1400->900 AMBIENT dry_O2
history.note: Below about 900 °C a 1400 °C oxide of 50 nm grows no more on this program's constants. 5 min is ours; searched from 30 s to 30 min.

history.item: In-situ doped polysilicon gate by LPCVD
history.paper: “All samples were grown with polysilicon in an in situ doping low-pressure chemical vapor deposition process”
history.note: Temperature and time not stated (typically 600 to 650 °C for tens of minutes): an extra anneal under the gate.

history.item: Sputtered Al, 1 µm, front and back
history.paper: “Both metal electrodes, i.e., backside and frontside, were Al electrodes that were all grown through a sputtering process. The thicknesses of the Al electrodes were all 1 µm.”

history.item: C-V and quasi-static C-V; FIB lamella, STEM-EDS line scan; SIMS
history.paper: “Energy-dispersive X-ray spectrometry was used to analyze the concentration distribution of carbon elements and oxygen elements at the SiO2/SiC interface.”
history.ours: the observables Thickness and interface state density; the EDS profile has no observable
